This event demonstrates a failure across social axes. Instead of proactive youth empowerment and transparent community resources, we see reactive policing after structural neglect creates volatile flashpoints.

The Unavoidable Lie: More policing alone solves structural youth alienation.

Actual Article Body:
Twelve teenagers were shot in the early morning on Sunday after gunfire broke out at a birthday party in Macon, Georgia.

Bibb County Sheriff David Davis said at a press conference that local high school students congregated at the skate park at Carolyn Crayton Park late Saturday night after being told to leave the Airbnb where the party was supposed to be held. Davis said another group of students arrived and the two exchanged words before gunfire erupted.

Actual Article Body:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

A dozen teens were shot after gunfire broke out at a chaotic birthday party gone awry inside a Georgia park Saturday night, according to local authorities and reports.

The shots broke out around midnight at Carolyn Crayton Park in Macon, where a “large gathering” had congregated following a birthday party at a nearby Airbnb, the Bibb County Sheriff’s Office said.

Two of the victims –- a 17-year-old boy and an 18-year-old boy — were left in critical condition, while the other 10 were listed in stable condition.

The group, which included high schoolers, had been asked to leave that Airbnb during their party, and ended up congregating at Crayton Park.

A separate group arrived at the park, and an argument broke out between them — before gunfire erupted and 12 were wounded, 13WMAZ reported.
